glory-edgeville.name: Amulet of glory - Edgeville
glory-edgeville.note: Rub in inventory or select Edgeville while equipped. Walk to Krystilia, or enter Edgeville Dungeon for Vannaka. Charged and eternal versions work; uncharged amulets do not. Edgeville bank is a short walk from the arrival point.

glory-draynor.name: Amulet of glory - Draynor Village
glory-draynor.note: Walk to Spria in Draynor Village after arrival. Draynor Village bank is nearby.

games-burthorpe.name: Games necklace - Burthorpe
games-burthorpe.note: Run east to Turael or Aya, south of the general store.

combat-warriors-guild.name: Combat bracelet - Warriors Guild
combat-warriors-guild.note: Continue to Turael or Aya in Burthorpe; entering the Warriors Guild is unnecessary.

passage-wizards-tower.name: Necklace of passage - Wizards Tower
passage-wizards-tower.note: Continue north to Spria in Draynor Village.

passage-outpost.name: Necklace of passage - Outpost
passage-outpost.note: Continue through the Tree Gnome Stronghold gates, then north-west to Nieve or Steve.

slayer-stronghold.name: Slayer ring - Stronghold Slayer Cave
slayer-stronghold.note: Nieve or Steve stands beside the cave. The ring Master dialogue cannot assign a new task; use the teleport and speak in person. The nearby Gnome Stronghold bank requires climbing one set of stairs. Teleport selection uses the ring menu.

slayer-tower.name: Slayer ring - Slayer Tower
slayer-tower.note: Continue south-east to Mazchna or Achtryn in north-eastern Canifis.

slayer-wyrmscraig.name: Slayer ring - Wyrmscraig Cavern
slayer-wyrmscraig.note: Continue through the cavern to Mortimer. This teleport requires the completed quest, beyond the partial quest access needed to receive tasks.

skills-farming-guild.name: Skills necklace - Farming Guild
skills-farming-guild.note: Continue north and climb Mount Karuulm to Konar. Below 45 Farming, arrival is outside the guild; no Farming level is required for this route.

wealth-grand-exchange.name: Ring of wealth - Grand Exchange
wealth-grand-exchange.note: An alternative escape destination. Use Rub in inventory or the equipped teleport option. Grand Exchange bankers are a short walk north. Continue north-west to Edgeville for Krystilia, or use the Edgeville Dungeon entrance for Vannaka.

dueling-ferox.name: Ring of dueling - Ferox Enclave
dueling-ferox.note: Level 20 Wilderness limit. Ferox is a safe enclave; Tele Block prevents entry and teleportation. The bank chest and banker are in the western part of the enclave, near the restoration pools.

royal-seed-pod.name: Royal seed pod
royal-seed-pod.note: Unlimited teleport. Use Commune; walk south-west for Nieve or Steve after returning. Commune is a one-click inventory escape. The Grand Tree bank is upstairs: climb one ladder, then walk to a banker. Arrival is not a safe area on PvP worlds.

grand-seed-pod.name: Grand seed pod
grand-seed-pod.note: Use Squash for the faster indoor-capable escape. Launch requires outdoors. Squash temporarily reduces Farming by 5; one pod is consumed. Squash is a right-click option, not the default Launch action. The Grand Tree bank is upstairs, reached by one ladder after Squash.

ectophial.name: Ectophial
ectophial.note: Only the filled ectophial is usable. It refills automatically after arrival; continue west to Canifis for Mazchna.

lumbridge-tablet.name: Lumbridge teleport (tablet)
lumbridge-tablet.note: Break one tablet; no Magic level or spellbook requirement for using an owned tablet. For banking, enter Lumbridge Castle and climb to the top-floor bank; no Recipe for Disaster cellar access is assumed. Continue west to Draynor Village for Spria.

kharyrll-tablet.name: Kharyrll teleport (tablet)
kharyrll-tablet.note: Break one tablet and continue to Mazchna. No casting Magic level or Ancient spellbook is needed, but Desert Treasure I is required to use the tablet. Canifis bank is beside the arrival pub.

karamja-gloves-duradel.name: Karamja gloves 4
karamja-gloves-duradel.note: Unlimited Slayer Master teleport directly beside Duradel or Kuradal; usable while carried or worn.

karamja-gloves-gem-mine.name: Karamja gloves 3
karamja-gloves-gem-mine.note: Unlimited Gem Mine teleport; climb out, cross the bridge south and continue east to Duradel or Kuradal.

rada-karuulm-unlimited.name: Rada's blessing 4
rada-karuulm-unlimited.note: Unlimited Mount Karuulm teleport beside Konar, usable while carried or worn. Mount Karuulm bank is a short walk from the arrival point.

rada-karuulm-daily.name: Rada's blessing 3
requirements: Mount Karuulm daily teleport charge remains
rada-karuulm-daily.note: Three Mount Karuulm teleports per day; remaining daily uses are not inferred from ownership. Check manually before departure. Mount Karuulm bank is a short walk from the arrival point.

pharaoh-jaleustrophos.name: Pharaoh's sceptre - Jaleustrophos
pharaoh-jaleustrophos.note: Choose Jaleustrophos in the teleport menu. Charged IDs establish at least one use; the total loaded charges are not inferred. Using it from inventory does not require wielding it.

crystal-lletya.name: Teleport crystal - Lletya
crystal-lletya.note: Use the Lletya destination; crystal seeds without charges are excluded. Lletya bank is nearby. Lletya can be configured as the left-click destination; the plugin does not inspect this toggle.

lumbridge-zanaris.name: Lumbridge tablet - walk to Zanaris
lumbridge-zanaris.note: Walk to the Lumbridge Swamp shed and enter Zanaris, then go south to Chaeldar. Pack a dramen or lunar staff and wield it to enter the shed; the chosen staff must be usable with your levels.

astral-contact-turael.name: Astral Contact - Turael
astral-contact-turael.note: Receive the next task remotely on the Lunar spellbook; this does not move the player or provide an escape. Runes are consumed when the contact interface opens.

astral-contact-spria.name: Astral Contact - Spria
astral-contact-spria.note: Receive the next task remotely on the Lunar spellbook; this does not move the player or provide an escape. Runes are consumed when the contact interface opens.

astral-contact-mazchna.name: Astral Contact - Mazchna
astral-contact-mazchna.note: Receive the next task remotely on the Lunar spellbook; this does not move the player or provide an escape. Runes are consumed when the contact interface opens.

astral-contact-vannaka.name: Astral Contact - Vannaka
astral-contact-vannaka.note: Receive the next task remotely on the Lunar spellbook; this does not move the player or provide an escape. Runes are consumed when the contact interface opens.

astral-contact-chaeldar.name: Astral Contact - Chaeldar
astral-contact-chaeldar.note: Receive the next task remotely on the Lunar spellbook; this does not move the player or provide an escape. Runes are consumed when the contact interface opens.

astral-contact-nieve.name: Astral Contact - Nieve
astral-contact-nieve.note: Receive the next task remotely on the Lunar spellbook; this does not move the player or provide an escape. Runes are consumed when the contact interface opens.

astral-contact-duradel.name: Astral Contact - Duradel
astral-contact-duradel.note: Receive the next task remotely on the Lunar spellbook; this does not move the player or provide an escape. Runes are consumed when the contact interface opens.

astral-contact-krystilia.name: Astral Contact - Krystilia
requirements: Krystilia has assigned the first Wilderness Slayer task
astral-contact-krystilia.note: Receive the next task remotely on the Lunar spellbook; this does not move the player or provide an escape. Runes are consumed when the contact interface opens.

astral-contact-konar.name: Astral Contact - Konar quo Maten
requirements: Konar Astral Contact unlocked by using Talk-to in person
astral-contact-konar.note: Receive the next task remotely on the Lunar spellbook; this does not move the player or provide an escape. Runes are consumed when the contact interface opens.

astral-contact-mortimer.name: Astral Contact - Mortimer
requirements: Fallen From Grace progressed to unlock Mortimer assignments
astral-contact-mortimer.note: Receive the next task remotely on the Lunar spellbook; this does not move the player or provide an escape. Runes are consumed when the contact interface opens.

lumbridge-spell.name: Lumbridge Teleport
lumbridge-spell.note: Continue west to Draynor Village for Spria. For banking, enter Lumbridge Castle and climb to the top-floor bank; no Recipe for Disaster cellar access is assumed.

varrock-spell.name: Varrock Teleport
varrock-spell.note: Continue north-west to Edgeville for Krystilia, or enter Edgeville Dungeon for Vannaka. Varrock west bank is available on the onward walk. The Grand Exchange destination requires the Medium Varrock Diary and is a separate route.

falador-spell.name: Falador Teleport
falador-spell.note: Continue north through Taverley to Burthorpe for Turael or Aya. Falador west bank is a short walk from the arrival point.

ardougne-spell.name: Ardougne Teleport
ardougne-spell.note: Requires the Ardougne teleport unlock. This is an escape destination, with any onward journey planned separately. East Ardougne southern bank is available a short walk south of the market.

kharyrll-spell.name: Kharyrll Teleport
kharyrll-spell.note: Continue to Mazchna or Achtryn in north-eastern Canifis. Canifis bank is beside the arrival pub.

battlefront-spell.name: Battlefront Teleport
battlefront-spell.note: Continue north and climb Mount Karuulm to Konar.

lumbridge-zanaris-spell.name: Lumbridge Teleport - Zanaris route
lumbridge-zanaris-spell.note: Walk to the swamp shed and wield a dramen or lunar staff to enter Zanaris; Chaeldar is south of the entrance.

moonclan-spell.name: Moonclan Teleport
moonclan-spell.note: Lunar escape option; retreat to level 20 Wilderness or below before casting. Lunar banking additionally needs a carried seal of passage, Dream Mentor completion for Birds-Eye Jack, or the Elite Fremennik Diary; use the reviewed bank routes for those conditions.

house-tablet.name: Teleport to house (tablet)
house-tablet.note: Break one owned tablet to return home; choose Inside for house facilities. Using the tablet has no Magic level or spellbook requirement. A house does not itself provide a bank.

house-spell.name: Teleport to House
house-spell.note: Cast Teleport to House and choose Inside for house facilities. Requires the Standard spellbook, level 40 Magic and the listed runes. A house does not itself provide a bank.

house-edgeville-tablet.name: House tablet - Edgeville via POH
requirements: POH has an Edgeville teleport (mounted glory or ornate jewellery box)
house-edgeville-tablet.note: Teleport inside your own house, then use its mounted glory or ornate jewellery box to reach Edgeville. The bank is nearby; walk north-east to Krystilia or enter Edgeville Dungeon for Vannaka. Furniture availability needs explicit account confirmation; ownership of a portable glory does not prove it.

house-bank-tablet.name: House tablet - bank via jewellery box
house-bank-tablet.destination: Castle Wars bank via player-owned house
house-bank-tablet.note: Teleport inside your own house, then use the jewellery box Castle Wars option for the nearby bank chest. Any jewellery box tier supports this route; its presence needs explicit account confirmation. No portable ring of dueling or furniture construction level is required to use an existing box.

house-edgeville-spell.name: House spell - Edgeville via POH
requirements: POH has an Edgeville teleport (mounted glory or ornate jewellery box)
house-edgeville-spell.note: Teleport inside your own house, then use its mounted glory or ornate jewellery box to reach Edgeville. The bank is nearby; walk north-east to Krystilia or enter Edgeville Dungeon for Vannaka. Furniture availability needs explicit account confirmation; ownership of a portable glory does not prove it.

house-bank-spell.name: House spell - bank via jewellery box
house-bank-spell.destination: Castle Wars bank via player-owned house
house-bank-spell.note: Teleport inside your own house, then use the jewellery box Castle Wars option for the nearby bank chest. Any jewellery box tier supports this route; its presence needs explicit account confirmation. No portable ring of dueling or furniture construction level is required to use an existing box.

dueling-castle-wars.name: Ring of dueling - Castle Wars
dueling-castle-wars.note: Use Rub in inventory or the equipped Castle Wars option. The bank chest is just a few tiles from arrival. Every listed item ID has at least one teleport charge.

combat-monastery.name: Combat bracelet - Edgeville Monastery
combat-monastery.note: Select Monastery, then walk east to Edgeville for Krystilia or the dungeon entrance for Vannaka. No Prayer level or guild entry is needed; owned charged bracelets work without the recharge quest requirements.

paddewwa-tablet.name: Paddewwa teleport (tablet)
paddewwa-tablet.note: Arrive inside Edgeville Dungeon. Continue through the dungeon to Vannaka, or climb the nearby exit ladder and walk north to Krystilia in Edgeville. Desert Treasure I is required. An owned tablet needs no casting Magic level or Ancient spellbook.

paddewwa-spell.name: Paddewwa Teleport
paddewwa-spell.note: Arrive inside Edgeville Dungeon. Continue through the dungeon to Vannaka, or climb the nearby exit ladder and walk north to Krystilia in Edgeville. Desert Treasure I is required. Casting requires the Ancient spellbook, level 54 Magic, two law runes, one air rune and one fire rune.

varrock-tablet.name: Varrock teleport (tablet)
varrock-tablet.note: Break one owned tablet; using it has no casting Magic level or spellbook requirement. Walk to Varrock west bank, or continue north-west to Edgeville for Krystilia or Vannaka. The Grand Exchange destination needs the Medium Varrock Diary and is a separate route.

falador-tablet.name: Falador teleport (tablet)
falador-tablet.note: Break one owned tablet; using it has no casting Magic level or spellbook requirement. Walk to Falador west bank. For Turael or Aya, continue north through Taverley to Burthorpe.

varrock-grand-exchange-tablet.name: Varrock tablet - Grand Exchange
varrock-grand-exchange-tablet.note: Choose the Grand Exchange destination, unlocked by the Medium Varrock Diary; bankers are nearby. The plugin does not inspect the default Varrock teleport destination. Continue north-west to Edgeville for Krystilia or the dungeon route to Vannaka.

varrock-grand-exchange-spell.name: Varrock spell - Grand Exchange
varrock-grand-exchange-spell.note: Choose the Grand Exchange destination, unlocked by the Medium Varrock Diary; bankers are nearby. The plugin does not inspect the default Varrock teleport destination. Continue north-west to Edgeville for Krystilia or the dungeon route to Vannaka.

moonclan-bank-spell.name: Moonclan Teleport - bank
requirements: Dream Mentor OR Elite Fremennik Diary
moonclan-bank-spell.note: Walk to the nearby Lunar Isle bank. After Dream Mentor, use Birds-Eye Jack; the Elite Fremennik Diary removes the seal requirement for all Lunar bankers. Do not assume that Lunar Diplomacy alone permits banking without a seal.

moonclan-bank-seal-spell.name: Moonclan Teleport - bank with seal of passage
moonclan-bank-seal-spell.note: Carry the seal of passage and walk to the nearby Lunar Isle bank. Holding it in inventory is sufficient; it does not need to replace equipped neckwear.

wildernessEscapeNotes: Most portable teleports work through Wilderness level 20; reviewed dragonstone jewellery, seed pods, Slayer rings and the pharaoh's sceptre work through level 30. Above the item limit, first reach a permitted Wilderness level; carrying an escape item does not make it usable at the current destination.

Tele Block prevents ordinary portable teleports, Wilderness levers and obelisks. Its normal duration is 5 minutes, or 2.5 minutes when Protect from Magic was active as it landed. This trip plan does not verify live Tele Block state or guarantee escape.
Artio, Spindel and Calvar'ion have a 3-tick teleport delay unless the Hard Wilderness Diary is complete. Boss-assignment access does not remove the delay.
In the Revenant Caves, teleporting while in NPC combat has a 2-tick delay that an incoming NPC attack can restart, unless the Hard Wilderness Diary is complete.
A brief PvP teleport lock can follow using a special attack against another player. Return and escape plans are conditional on teleport availability; no live combat timing is inferred.
Ring of life, Defence cape and Escape crystal automatic effects are not guaranteed manual escape substitutes. Chronicle and minigame teleports do not provide Wilderness escape coverage.

Blighted food and restores are used only for a Wilderness combat destination in this ordinary-world planner. Wilderness travel to a non-Wilderness room such as the King Black Dragon lair does not make those supplies usable there.
Blighted teleport spell sacks supply offensive Tele Block or Teleport to Target casts; they do not teleport the carrier to safety.
lootingBagNotes: A looting bag occupies one of the 28 inventory slots and holds up to 28 loot stacks. Its contents are unavailable as food, potions, runes or equipment during the trip; it does not create extra usable supply slots.

Only tradeable items can be deposited in the Wilderness, including Ferox Enclave on an ordinary world. Contents are normally recovered through a bank. Only one looting bag may be possessed; a looting bag note must first be exchanged at a bank.
On a Wilderness PvP death the bag is always lost; the killer receives its contents except food and potions. On a Wilderness PvM death the bag is destroyed and all contents go to the gravestone.

Destroying the bag outside Wilderness on an ordinary world, including Ferox Enclave, destroys all contents. Destroying it in Wilderness drops contents publicly and destroys unnoted cooked food, potions and vials of water.
